title: MapleStory Worlds Global Launch One Year Anniversary Screenshot Contest
original_title: MapleStory Worlds Global Launch One Year Anniversary Screenshot Contest
author: MSW_Creators
summary: Creators in the United States and Canada excluding Quebec could enter the April 23-May 4 MapleStory Worlds anniversary screenshot contest by submitting a Creator Circle World photobooth image through Discord.

images.alt: MapleStory Worlds Global Launch One Year Anniversary Screenshot Contest

sections.title: Contest period
items: Entries were accepted from April 23 at 11:00 PT through May 4 at 23:59 PT.
Three winners were selected from eligible Discord submissions.

sections.title: Entry
items: Visit the Creator Circle World photobooth.
Submit the screenshot through the official contest channel in Discord.
Participation was limited to the United States and Canada excluding Quebec.

notes: Reclassified as an event on 2026-07-27 after verifying the contest period, entry method, and eligibility against the official Creator Center notice. The prior structured record is retained in snapshots.
event_name: MapleStory Worlds Global Launch One Year Anniversary Screenshot Contest
eligibility: Residents of the United States and Canada, excluding Quebec
requirements: Capture an eligible screenshot in the Creator Circle World photobooth.
Submit the screenshot through the official MapleStory Worlds Discord contest channel.
rewards: World Coins, Noodle Bucks, or Chrono Credits for three selected winners
participation_steps: Submit it in the official Discord contest channel before the deadline.
